'''Repplic''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Csilla (star)|Csilla]] in the [[Csilla system/Legends|Csilla system]]. Repplic occupied the third orbital position and had twenty-two [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. The [[Gas/Legends|gas]] giant was located in [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] controlled by the Chiss Ascendancy.<ref name="TEA" />

Along with the rest of the Csilla [[Star system/Legends|system]], Repplic was linked by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] known as the [[Path of the Houses]] to the [[Cioral system/Legends|Cioral]] and [[Sposia system/Legends|Sposia systems]]. The [[Cressus Route]] and [[Vagaari Corridor]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes connected the system to the [[Avidich system/Legends|Avidich]] and [[Cormit system/Legends|Cormit systems]], respectively, while other hyperlanes linked it to the [[Jamiron system/Legends|Jamiron]], [[Rentor system/Legends|Rentor]], and [[Rhigar system/Legends|Rhigar systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Repplic was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square F-8.<ref name="TEA" />
